thread:
Erin K: Heads-up — customer reported SSE resume returning the tail of an in-flight chunk twice and the Console shows the route as STALLED. Prod us-east-1, route=/v1/streams/chat. Anyone seen this? :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Jamal S: Saw something similar last night. Quick repro: 1) open SSE, 2) simulate 4s TCP blackhole, 3) client reconnects with `Last-Event-ID: abc123` and server re-emits the last ~400 bytes. Console shows resumed but with duplicated tokens. Minimal logs below.
```
[2026-03-18T02:20:15Z] connection=abcd state=streaming seq=... last_event_id=abc123
[2026-03-18T02:20:19Z] connection=abcd tcp=conn_reset
[2026-03-18T02:20:20Z] router: resume-request id=abc123 from client
[2026-03-18T02:20:20Z] runtime: replaying tail bytes offset=98765 len=432
[2026-03-18T02:20:20Z] runtime: delivered chunk id=chunk-xyz offset_range=98433-98865
```
Priya M: If runtime replays the tail and billing counts emitted tokens on the server side, customer could be billed twice for the same tokens. We need to confirm whether the billing pipeline dedups by resume id or by token offset.
Lucas R: My hunch: proxy keepalive vs client retry mismatch. Envoy idle timeout=15s, client retries at 5s -> client attempts resume while backend still considers stream live and may replay buffer tail. Also check `resume_idempotency_key` handling in runtime.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T02:21 by jamal promoted to prod-us-east-1 :rocket:
Erin K: Plan: 1) add a short telemetry flag to identify duplicated-last-chunk events, 2) make a small console UX change to surface suspected resumed-duplicate traces on the route page, 3) patch router/runtime to ignore bytes <= resume_offset if already delivered. Thoughts?
Priya M: I'll audit billing dedupe. If duplicates occur, we should hold charges and create a rate-limited refund path. Also add an alert on `billing.token_count` deltas vs `ingest.tokens`.
Jamal S: Proposed quick fix: add header on resume `X-Resume-Expect-Offset: <n>` and have runtime treat any bytes <= n as already ACKed (no emit). I'll open a tiny PR to canary in eng-runtime.
Lucas R: I'll own metrics. Add `sse.resume.duplicate_chunks` and tag by `route`, `backend`, `proxy` and `resume_cause` (tcp-reset/keepalive/slow-client). Put a Grafana panel in the streaming dashboard.
Erin K: Sounds good. Also can we add a lightweight console indicator: "Resume suspected duplicates: 3 in last hour" on route health so support can triage quickly?
metrics-bot: Metric alert created: sse.resume.duplicate_chunks >= 3 in 1h -> notify #oncall.
Erin K: OK assigning follow-ups: Jamal = small runtime header change + canary, Lucas = grafana + metric, Priya = billing audit + alert safeguards, I'll own console UX flag and telemetry. If we see >=3 dup events in 1h -> page oncall @oncall.
Jamal S: pushing canary now. Will report back with logs.
Priya M: started billing replay checks, will update in thread.
Lucas R: dashboard draft up in ~30m, linking when ready.
Erin K: Thanks team. Keeping this open until we have both canary results and billing audit. :thumbsup:
